subject: Utilization-triggered GPU top-up and credit conversion request
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa@apexanalytics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Apex Analytics Finance <finance@apexanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in utilization — request for short-term GPU top-up / credit conversion

Hi Dylan,

We had a sustained utilization spike the last 6 weeks across our inference fleet (see attached utilization_report_Apex_202607.pdf). Peak queued requests and tail latency have been hitting our SLA-sensitive workloads — the ops team is reporting degraded customer experience during business hours.

Numbers at a glance:
- Sustained GPU utilization ~88-92% over 6 weeks
- Short bursts to 98% for several 30–45m windows
- Queues causing max latency 2.1x above baseline for customer-facing endpoints

We need a pragmatic, fast path to relieve pressure while we complete model sharding and KV cache tuning. Two options we'd like you to price/execute:
1) Convert the outstanding overage balance (we estimate ~$95k available credits this quarter) into short-term committed capacity (GPU-months) that can be provisioned immediately.
2) Provision a temporary paid burst pool (16 x A100 equivalent) for 90 days starting Sep 1 — we can convert it to committed capacity if utilization remains high.

Can you confirm feasibility and provide a short proposal + lead time? If possible, we'd like provisioning in the first week of Sep.

Thanks,
Lisa Park
Head of Infrastructure
Apex Analytics

Attachments: utilization_report_Apex_202607.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@apexanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in utilization — request for short-term GPU top-up / credit conversion

Hi Lisa — thanks for the details and the report, that helps a lot.

Short answers up front: yes, we can do both conversion and temporary burst capacity. Tradeoffs and lead times below.

Option A — credit-to-commit conversion
- We can convert credits into committed GPU-months against your Dedicated pool. For example, ~$95k converts to ~8 x A100-equiv GPU-months (depending on exact SKU mix).
- Changes are contractual (amendment) and take ~5–7 business days to execute once we have signoff. Provisioning of committed capacity is immediate after the contract is applied.

Option B — 90-day burst pool
- We can allocate a burst pool (16 A100-equivalents) within 24–48 hours once billing is cleared. This is the fastest operational lift.
- Pricing for burst is slightly higher than committed, but convertible to committed if you notify us before the burst ends.

To size this correctly, two asks from our side:
1) Can you share a 72‑hour per-minute utilization sample (not aggregated) for the highest-impact endpoints? That will let us estimate queuing wins from short bursts vs committed.
2) Confirm whether you want the conversion to be strictly GPU-months tied to your Dedicated fleet or converted to refundable credits you can apply to Hosted bursts.

Attaching a provisional pricing sheet for quick reference. If it works, we can prepare an amendment draft and route through legal.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Monday to lock sizing and conversion amount. What time works for you?

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: provisional-pricing-sheet.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in utilization — request for short-term GPU top-up / credit conversion

Dylan / Karthik — looping in suggested commercial approach.

Summary suggestion (for customer-facing amendment):
- Convert $95k of overage/credits into 8 A100-equivalent GPU-months allocated to Apex's Dedicated pool, applied retroactively starting Sep 1 for a 4-month window.
- Provide option to expand to 12 GPU-months if utilization remains above 80% for 3 consecutive weeks — auto-approval up to an additional $40k commitment.
- If Apex prefers immediate relief, offer 16 A100 burst pool for 90 days at burst rates; maintain convertibility to committed GPU-months with partial credit conversion.

Operational notes:
- Legal will need the amendment_draft_v2.docx language refined for the auto-conversion clause and rollover credits.
- Provisioning lead time for burst pool: 24–48 hours after PO/payment confirmation.
- Provisioning for committed GPU-months is immediate once amendment signed and applied to the org; confirm target SKU mix (A100 vs H100).

Please draft the customer-facing proposal and I'll review. If we can move quickly we'll offer the 90-day burst as a short-term goodwill step while the credit conversion is executed.

Marissa Cole
Director, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
